# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

- **In Looking Glass itself:** report it privately through this repository's Security tab:
  [**Report a vulnerability**](https://github.com/anonghosty/looking-glass/security/advisories/new) (GitHub private
  vulnerability reporting). Please do not open a public issue. Include the steps to reproduce and the version (release
  tag or commit) you run.
- **In an installation:** report it to the CSIRT team that runs it.

Fixed vulnerabilities are listed under **Security** in the release notes and in [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md).

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made on the latest release (the `main` branch). Update with the steps in
[INSTALLATION.md → Updating](../docs/INSTALLATION.md#updating).
